HOW A PAPER MOVES THROUGH THE TOOL
Each box is one step, named as the progress timeline and the Rerun Agent dialog
name it, with the timeline stage it is grouped under. An arrow means "when this
step finishes, the next one starts"; its label says what is handed on, and when
Re-running a step also re-runs every step below it, unless you tick "Skip
successor tasks". A note you add to a re-run reaches every step below it too.
"Quick run" re-runs on a faster, lower-cost AI model.
Fix things at the step that first got them wrong: a step only sees what the
steps above it handed on. Re-running a step rewrites what that step produced,
which can replace your edits to it; the steps below start from the paper page
Dashed arrows: the final check waits until every other step of the paper has
finished. Box colour says how often a step runs:
